entries.text: Designed a new look for the Little Dart Mk VI: The hull is now matte black, with subtle metallic silver detailing along the wings and engines, giving it a futuristic and sleek appearance.
curl up on the workbench with the sketchpad, eyes gleaming with design ideas
entries.why: I'm itching to finish the Little Dart’s sleek design and ready for the next step
entries.detail: I sit on the bench with the sketchpad in hand, my eyes glinting with the idea. The Little Dart needs a more modern look, sleeker and faster. How about a series of sleek, reflective segments?

entries.text: Wrote in his diary: "Design Notes for Little Dart Mk VI"
